title: Review: full project pre-merge deep review
notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — Two production-path hardcoded secrets (signing key, HLC node ID) make operator deployments indistinguishable and signing useless. The unbounded article read is a trivial DoS. These are not theoretical — they fire on first deployment.
Confidence: 25% chance of a missed P1 bug. Uncertainty driven by: (a) transit main.rs gossip reconciliation path — the 'MUST call verify_entry()' TODO comment was not followed up to confirm whether backfill will eventually merge unverified entries; (b) mail/jmap crate got lighter treatment than core/reader/transit. Would raise confidence if: transit backfill fetch implementation is reviewed when it lands, and a JMAP conformance test is added.
